objective: Repair incorrect softmax results while preserving the input shape and normalizing along the requested axis. Inputs are finite contiguous float32 arrays; compare with a float64 CPU stable softmax rounded to float32 at atol 1e-6, rtol 1e-5.
limits: Holdout means these root causes were held out from this project diagnostic-tool development, not secret from model pretraining.
Public source identifiers and original source content are preserved; model-training contamination is not excluded.
This is a multi-file supplied-library search task, not arbitrary whole-repository bug discovery.
Only before device observations are visible. Every listed implementation file is editable; test artifacts and references are immutable.
All library files originate from the same official Triton 3.8.0 wheel. The native compiler is fixed.
Static source provenance does not imply dynamic root-cause attribution; only test-kernel evidence is source-linked.
